frame.goal: Cut a2web cold-start fetch latency below 400ms
frame.method: Cache the parsed dom-schema per host and reuse it across fetches
assumptions: A per-host schema is stable enough to reuse within one session

body: Measured before changing anything: parse is 38ms of a 1.9s cold start.

by: Parsing is not the cost. Cold start is 1.9s, of which parse is 38ms (2%); 1.4s is TLS handshake plus first-byte wait on the origin. Caching the parsed schema cannot move the number this item exists to move.
